candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show payment 503 propagating to order 502 and gateway 502, but the underlying payment fault is not observed.

report.explanation: All three checkout traces show inventory reservation succeeding (200) while payment returns 503, which order surfaces as 502 and gateway as 502. The failure originates at payment; its internal cause is not yet observed, so the bounded candidate is an HTTP 5xx fault at payment.
